vertical: cross (permits-3: state air-permit search over 20 profiled plants; 13 evidence rows written for 6 plants in v-mining-heavy-equipment, v-shipbuilding-naval and v-poles-substation)
decision_rule: Corrected = the value adds a fact the cited page does not show, tags a judgement as stated, places a company-level fact at the plant, ties a posting through a shared city, misdates a posting, or the quote is not on the page (raw source checked first); Confirmed otherwise. Unreachable only if the source cannot be reached at all. For scanned permits the page image is the document; an OCR misreading carried into a value is corrected.
error_rate_note: 1/13 = 7.7% (all rows). Stated rows only: 1/12 = 8.3%. The one correction is an OCR misreading in a scanned Iowa construction permit (PPI Pella unit range 'EU 2a to EU 21' should be 'EU 2a to EU 2l', twelve units); no plant, address, date, process, material or score is affected. Every quote is on its page (case-sensitive, whitespace-normalised, OCR layer for the two Iowa scans); the inferred Kentucky eSearch row was re-run through its POST JSON API. No score_* rows, no evidence_remove key in the inbox file.
worst_errors: p-ppi-pella-ia:prospect_test (Iowa DNR 08-A-455) - value gives the welding units as 'EU 2a to EU 21' from the OCR layer; the scan reads 'EU 2a to EU 2l (12 units)'. Corrected to 'EU 2a to EU 2l'; quote kept as the OCR text. Minor; no score effect.

None other. Nearest boundary: p-syntron-saltillo-ms:materials names the laser cutting system but its quote carries only the plasma line (laser is on the same page, AA-032; confirmed, fuller quote offered in the note).

Boundary (not an error): p-syntron-saltillo-ms:address states '2730 Highway 145 North' while plants.csv has '2730 Hwy 145 South'; ECHO ties both to one facility (FRS 110000375898 carries ICIS-Air MS0000002808100099 at 2730 HIGHWAY 145 NORTH).
score_notes: No score_* rows in permits-3.json, so no score_labor row to check. Score changes written by the inbox: none. Score changes from this check: none.

Coordinator rulings the merge opens (not errors): (1) p-jamesbuilt-calvert-city-ky score_process 0: weld_processes is now stated GMAW and SMAW for the James Built operation (Title V insignificant activities, revised 2026-06-26). GMAW is MIG; SMAW is not TIG, so the 'mixed with TIG' 12 does not apply; whether insignificant-activity GMAW counts as 'MIG on production weldments' (20) is a ruling. Site tie to 390 Riverside Ln is inferred (separate row), so any points earned that rest on it may earn no confidence. (2) p-musco-muscatine-ia score_process 0 and score_material_part 0: stated GMAW on aluminum at the site (2013, 13 years old): process rule gives 20 for MIG on production weldments, but the welded parts are aluminum and steel-pole welding at Muscatine is unstated; material and part fit may be the aluminum-first 4. (3) p-syntron-saltillo-ms: welding now stated at the site (2025 permit) and stainless steel weldments stated; process still unknown ('automatic welder and portable welding units' names no process), so process stays 0; material_part needs a part-size fact. (4) Quality Mfg, PPI, Bollinger: welding stated as of the document date only; no score component changes on prospect_test alone.
plant_status_notes: All six permits name the ledger plant's address except Syntron (North vs South, one ECHO facility) and JamesBuilt (permit source location 476 vs ledger 390 Riverside Lane; one Kentucky Agency Interest 2938 filed at 390). Current-status evidence in the permits: Syntron SMOP in force to 2027-04-30; JamesBuilt Title V revised 2026-06-26, in force to 2027-02-11; Bollinger Title V face expiry 2026-01-31 (renewal reported pending, not re-read); Quality Mfg Title V expired 2025-05-04 and 'Archived' per the inbox notes (current permit status not checked; a WebSearch discovery shows 2026 Urbandale hiring, not a quote); PPI 2008 and Musco 2013 construction permits carry no current status. No closure found.

At merge, retire or sync the superseded rows: p-syntron-saltillo-ms:materials (inferred company-level elevator-bucket row, value differs from the new plants.materials); p-jamesbuilt-calvert-city-ky:weld_processes (inferred 'unknown' row, jamesmarine.com jobs page); p-musco-muscatine-ia:weld_processes (unknown row by review-fix-coverage). method: Fresh curl of every cited URL into a new scratch directory (6 PDFs, HTTP 200); pdftotext -layout and -raw; scripted fragment check of every quote (split on '...', whitespace-normalised, case-sensitive). Iowa scans: pages rendered with pdftoppm and read visually to check the OCR (PPI unit range, Musco date and 'GMAW'). Kentucky eSearch inferred row re-run as its public POST JSON search. EPA ECHO DFR 110000375898 fetched to tie the Syntron permit to the ledger facility. Negative clauses ('process not named', 'material not named') checked by grep on each document. web.archive.org reset in the proxy, so the two archive_urls were not re-verified (sources themselves were fetched, so nothing is unreachable). One WebSearch for discovery (Quality Mfg status), not quoted. No ledger or inbox file edited.

No plants.csv field changes from this check (prospect_test is not a plants.csv column). Retire the superseded rows listed in field_drift_notes.
